_comment: Per-run bnbcode config. Copied into each run folder by mkcell. Continual work is left at its DEFAULT (on) -- omitting the continual_work key is what 'default' means; setting {"enabled": false} is the off arm, which this kit does not run. Note that 'on' only arms the mechanism: it does nothing until the model itself calls continue_work({mode, north_star}).

permission._comment: A guardrail against accidents, not a sandbox: bash is not path-gated, and python -c reaches the same effect. The point is that the two harnesses get EQUAL freedom, so this list and claude_settings.json must be read side by side.
permission.question: deny
